flavor.text: Swalot has no teeth, so what it eats, it swallows whole, no matter what. Its cavernous mouth yawns widely. An automobile tire could easily fit inside this Pokémon’s mouth.
When Swalot spots prey, it spurts out a hideously toxic fluid from its pores and sprays the target. Once the prey has weakened, this Pokémon gulps it down whole with its cavernous mouth.
It gulps anything that fits in its mouth. Its special enzymes can dissolve anything.
It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.
It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp. It secretes a horribly toxic fluid from the pores on its body.
Its powerful stomach acid is capable of digesting almost anything. The one thing in the whole world a SWALOT can’t digest is its own stomach.

abilities.name: Liquid Ooze
abilities.description: The strong stench of the Pokémon's oozed liquid damages attackers that use HP-draining moves.

abilities.name: Sticky Hold
abilities.description: The Pokémon's held items cling to its sticky body and cannot be removed by other Pokémon.

abilities.name: Gluttony
abilities.description: If the Pokémon is holding a Berry to be eaten when its HP is low, it will instead eat the Berry when its HP drops to half or less.
